title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Commercial Placement Band Rates
content:
| Required amount on the loan's first notice | Rate per 100 for a commercial placement |
|---|---|
| Below 150000 dollars | 1.20 |
| At least 150000 dollars and below 400000 dollars | The tier's building rate per 100 |
| 400000 dollars or more | 0.98 |

**Commercial placement band rate — Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs, Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building tier.** For a placement priced under the commercial placement schedule, the rate per 100 for a commercial placement is 0.98 when the required amount on the loan's first notice is 400000 dollars or more, 1.20 when it is below 150000 dollars, and the tier's building rate per 100 when it is at least 150000 but below 400000 dollars. The required amount read is the one stated on the first notice of the loan being placed.

**Edges.** An amount of exactly 150000 dollars falls in the middle band and takes the tier's building rate per 100; an amount of 149,999 dollars takes 1.20. An amount of exactly 400000 dollars takes 0.98; 399,999 dollars takes the tier's building rate per 100.
